fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-08-21, a parked car of the complainant near Nallur Park Main Street was defaced and partly broken. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-08-18 at roughly 21:35. Jagan Sekar reported the matter orally at Chennai North PS; the contact number given was 9000000355. Kavitha Selvam (9000000099) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unidentified persons allegedly damaged the property while it was unattended.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, main street, witness, night, associate, photograph
